title: Case envelope estimate
description: The envelope estimate a case provides (MiSArch: timing/envelope-estimate-v2.json, timing/README.md §6): per handler the CPU an effect step pays for running in a transaction of its own (dispatch, decoding, idempotency, begin/commit) as opposed to its work, and per service the callee envelope of a synchronous invocation; its request rows give the receiving envelope of a synchronous call across containers (derive Envelope.inbound). core/generator/derive.py class Envelope reads it when timing/parts.json has no `envelope` (parts version 2); the same object is parts.json's `envelope` in version 3.

callees.description: service -> callee envelope (derive Envelope.callee; else the service's handler mean, else all handlers' mean).

rows.description: Per (request type, container) the profile shares x D (derive Envelope.inbound: D x (dispatch + decode + tx) of a query type's plan container without deliveries). Reads type, container, D, shares.dispatch/decode/tx, deliveriesPerReq, sampledMs.

requestOverhead.description: request type -> its entry operation and plan containers (derive Envelope.inbound reads entryOperation and the keys of byPlanContainer).

handler.description: A handler (reaction) of the timing campaign, by operation id. Also carries (not read by the generator): topic, types, envelopeCpuMs, envelopeParts, from, flag, workFrom, idempotencyCheck, countersRemainderCpuMs.

service.description: Service of the handler (derive Envelope.by_svc: pooled envelope per service).

envelopeAppCpuMs.description: App-side envelope CPU ms (dispatch, decode, idempotency, transaction) (derive Envelope.share, pooled).

workCpuMs.description: Work CPU ms (business logic and statements); must be a number for a handler of a reaction the workload reaches (derive Envelope.share).

callee.description: Callee envelope of a synchronous invocation of a service. Also carries (not read by the generator): dispatchCpuMs, decodeCpuMs, txCpuMs, types, flag.

envelopeAppCpuMs.description: Envelope CPU ms; ignored unless a number (derive Envelope.callee).
